name: io.github.suseendar1414/pursestring
title: PurseString
description: Spend policy and human approvals for AI agents, checked before a single-use capped card is issued.

environmentVariables.name: LITHIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Use Lithic virtual cards (sandbox by default) instead of the mock rail

environmentVariables.name: PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Enable PayPal payouts to vendor accounts set in the policy (sandbox by default)

environmentVariables.name: PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: PayPal client secret, needed with PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Slack incoming webhook for approval requests
